messages:
alex: Escalation from a Private customer — their collector is getting 403 on our presign PUTs right after a scheduled token rotation. Need a reproducible artifact and upload fallback. Request IDs from their pod logs below.

maria: Paste the collector version, k8s node, and the exact error lines (full stdout/stderr) plus the UTC time range.

alex: Collector: 1.12.4 (static build)
K8s: EKS, node ip=10.10.4.22, private-control-plane=true
Time range: 2026-03-15T14:02:10Z -> 2026-03-15T14:07:00Z
Request IDs: collector_req=cr-20260315-9f2a, s3 x-amz-request-id=G4X6H7K9
Log excerpt: 
```
ERROR: upload failed: presign PUT -> status=403, obj=acme-debug-20260315.tar.gz, err=AccessDenied
uploader: signed-url write error (403) x-amz-request-id=G4X6H7K9 auth=rotated-token
```

josh: @on-call-sre :thinking: Likely causes: presign signer issued URL with expired/old creds, IAM VPC endpoint policy deny, or clock skew. Ask customer to run a curl PUT repro with --trace to capture TLS/write behavior.

alex: Provided curl to customer, they ran it and got HTTP/1.1 403. Their trace shows the server responded 403 immediately on the PUT. Command we gave them to run: 
```
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGN_URL>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" \
  --data-binary @acme-debugbundle.tar.gz \
  --trace-ascii curl_trace.txt
```
They attached curl_trace.txt showing 403 at the PUT step.

maria: Collect these artifacts before we ask infra to touch policies:
- full collector stdout/stderr for the window (kubectl logs --since-time)
- journalctl -u redwood-collector -n 200 on node if systemd
- control-plane presign log for the presign request id (controlplane request_id)
- curl --trace-ascii output from customer
- exact presign URL (REDACT query except last 8 chars)
- collector config and k8s manifest (redact secrets)

kai: To make a local match of what they upload, run our collector collect command that produces the same tarball layout and manifest we expect: 
```
/opt/redwood/collector collect --mode debug \
  --output /tmp/acme-repro-20260315.tar.gz \
  --include-logs "/var/log/redwood/*.log" \
  --manifest /tmp/manifest.json \
  --redact-regex '(?i)(?:password|secret|token|ssn|acct|email)' \
  --strip-paths '/home/*/.aws'
```
Make sure --redact-regex is exact to avoid leaking PII. The manifest contains file checksums; include it in uploads.

alex: Customer notes: they have custom account IDs and US SSN-ish patterns. Suggested additional redact: `--redact-regex '(?:\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b|\\b\\d{4}-\\d{4}-\\d{4}-\\d{4}\\b)'` — they will add and re-run.

support-bot: ACTION ITEMS: gather collector logs, presign control-plane logs, curl trace, presign URL (redacted), reproduce bundle, sha256 of bundle. Mark P1 if upload attempts fail >30m.

maria: Fallback upload strategy if presign PUT keeps returning 403: 
1) Regenerate presign from control plane with TTL 60s and attempt PUT from same node as collector. Capture new controlplane request_id.
2) If still 403, check CloudTrail for Deny events against the S3 bucket (vpce/iam deny). Ask infra to hold changes if Deny seen.
3) Emergency fallback: SCP the bundle to our bastion (bundle@bastion.redwood.internal:/incoming) and we pull it from there. Provide scp instructions to customer and ensure we rotate the bastion upload key afterwards.

josh: Also ask customer to POST to our presign endpoint to confirm signer is returning a usable URL and that controlplane accepts their token. Example reproducer: 
```
curl -v -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/presign" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"object":"acme-debug-20260315.tar.gz","ttl":60}'
```
Record the JSON response and server-side request_id.

kai: Support handoff checklist to include in ticket: 
- [ ] collector version + pod spec + node id
- [ ] all request IDs (collector, controlplane, s3)
- [ ] exact UTC time window
- [ ] curl --trace-ascii output and sha256 of uploaded file (if any)
- [ ] redacted presign URL (show last 8 chars only)
- [ ] produced debug bundle + manifest + sha256
- [ ] any recent IAM/VPC endpoint policy changes
- [ ] token rotation timestamps (was rotation within 5m of failures?)

alex: Customer attempted uploading to a proxy which also returned 403. They will try scp to our bastion later tonight local time (expected 02:30 local / 09:30 UTC) and will also run collector collect command and upload the tarball. I'll post traces here when they run the PUT attempt.

maria: When we receive the bundle on our side, run these validations: 
1) sha256sum bundle -> compare to manifest
2) tar -tzf bundle | head -n 30 to sanity-check presence of manifest and logs
3) run debug-unpack tool: 
```
debug-unpack --input acme-debug-20260315.tar.gz --validate --redaction-check
```
If any file fails redaction checks, return a clear list of filenames and patterns to the customer.

on-call-sre: If CloudTrail shows Deny events for a vpce or role, ping eng-infra immediately — those denys usually indicate endpoint policy mismatch or KMS/role binding problem. Also look at S3 Block Public Access flags; presign PUTs can fail in unusual configurations.

josh: I'll own the repro/pull from bastion once the bundle lands. ETA ~2 hours after upload. @maria please keep the ticket comments updated with each artifact.

alex: Customer confirmed scp attempt to bastion scheduled at 09:30 UTC. Will paste curl_trace and controlplane request_id after they attempt presign again.

support-bot: THREAD STATUS: keep open until we have successful bundle validation. If upload fails for >30m escalate to infra. :warning:
